content:
Omar Diaz: Hi all  first week at Redwood. Received my MacBook Pro but during setup it immediately shows a firmware/activation lock screen referencing another Apple ID. Kandji can't enroll because it never gets past activation lock. Who do I ping for devices that look like they're from a previous owner?
IT Ops Bot: Ticket created: https://support.redwood.example/ticket/INC-5012 (assigned to device-team).
Claire Nguyen: Welcome Omar. Can you confirm the serial# and model shown on the activation lock screen? Also, was this purchased from Redwood or a partner?
Omar Diaz: Serial: C02XYZ987654, model MacBookPro17,1. People Ops said it was company-issued yesterday. I set it up from the sealed box.
Ruben Torres: If it's truly company-issued but shows another Apple ID, likely ABM/MDM deprovisioning didn't finish before shipping or the device was previously re-assigned. I'll check ABM. Can you snap a quick photo of the activation screen and DM it?
Omar Diaz: Photo sent in DM.
Ruben Torres: Thanks. ABM shows the serial assigned to Redwood, but the device state is "Activation Lock: On" with an associated Apple ID email (redacted). That means the device was not properly removed from the prior owner's iCloud before enrollment. We can either: 1) ask Apple to remove Activation Lock (requires proof of purchase) or 2) run Apple Configurator restore if we have the device in-hand. Are you remote?
Omar Diaz: I'm remote in SF. Packed the box up and shipped to me. Don't have Apple Configurator access.
Claire Nguyen: For remote staff the fastest is to ship the device into HQ-support or an Apple Store with the company PO and packing slip. But before doing that, we can try a remote recovery: we can reassign the serial in ABM and push a remote wipe; sometimes that clears the lock if ABM state was inconsistent. I'll attempt that now and post updates.
IT Ops Bot: Action: ABM record reassigned to Omar Diaz at 2134567896.
Omar Diaz: Rebooted the device after a minute. Still shows Activation Lock with the same partial Apple ID.
Ruben Torres: Hmm. If activation lock remains, it's at Apple/iCloud level. Please open the support ticket (link above) and upload the company PO and shipping invoice. I'll attach device proof on our side. Apple support turnaround is typically 24-72h. Meanwhile, I'll authorize a temporary loaner device so you're not blocked.
People Ops Bot: Loaner request approved. Logistics: tracking 1Z999999999; ETA 2 days.
Omar Diaz: Appreciate it. Any risk to the original device if Apple clears it? Will Kandji pick it up automatically if cleared?
Claire Nguyen: Once Apple removes Activation Lock and the device is reset, ABM assignment will let Kandji enroll on first boot. We'll confirm and close the ticket. If Apple requires physical check, we'll schedule a courier.
IT Ops Bot: Ticket INC-5012 updated: awaiting Apple removal confirmation.
Omar Diaz: Update: Apple responded and removed Activation Lock after we provided PO. They asked to power-cycle and connect to wifi. Rebooted and now I'm at macOS setup assistant. Kandji enrollment started and prompted for FileVault.
Ruben Torres: Great. Let FileVault finish and accept escrow. We'll verify ABM shows device active and MDM enrolled. If any app installs fail, ping devex.
Omar Diaz: Enrollment completed, FileVault escrowed, logged into Slack. Thanks for the loaner and fast triage team! :tada:
Claire Nguyen: Welcome aboard Omar. We'll log the workflow in the new-hires runbook so future remote shipments with activation locks are handled faster.
